supplied_sources.excerpt:
name: Protected Path Alarm

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  protected-paths:
    name: Detect protected path changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout full history
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Use Node.js 20
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Detect pushed protected paths
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        env:
          NTFY_TOPIC: ${{ secrets.NTFY_TOPIC }}
        run: >-
          node scripts/check-protected-paths.js
          "${{ github.event.before }}"
          "${{ github.sha }}"
          "origin/${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}"

      - name: Detect pull request protected paths
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          NTFY_TOPIC: ${{ secrets.NTFY_TOPIC }}
        run: node scripts/check-protected-paths.js "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}" "${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}"

  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  protected-paths:
    name: Detect protected path changes

        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Use Node.js 20

          node-version: '20'

      - name: Detect pushed protected paths
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        env:
          NTFY_TOPIC: ${{ secrets.NTFY_TOPIC }}

          "${{ github.sha }}"
          "origin/${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}"
